component.name: Paynal
component.summary: Lightning-fast, CLI-first API client, routine runner, and AI agent testing engine

description.p: Paynal is a high-performance, CLI-first API client, routine runner, and AI agent testing engine written in Rust.

ul.li: Pure-Rust TLS and lightweight runtime with zero Electron overhead
Git-native collaboration storing requests and multi-step routines in readable YAML
Dynamic variable chaining and runtime values (${$uuid}, ${$timestamp}, etc.)
Automatic retries with backoff and configurable timeouts
Built-in CI reporters (JUnit XML, JSON, Human) and exit code propagation
Interactive Terminal UI (TUI) dashboard with folder trees and variable editor
Native Model Context Protocol (MCP) server mode for AI agents
